MD4C 0.5.2, vendored from the release-0.5.2 tag:
https://github.com/mity/md4c/tree/release-0.5.2

The native app compiles md4c.c with MD4C_USE_UTF16 and uses its callbacks to
render Markdown through Win32 GDI. entity.c supplies named HTML entity decoding.
No HTML renderer, browser, network access, or runtime DLL is required.
License: MIT; see LICENSE.md, also embedded in chat.exe as resource 103.
